message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Adjustment Ratio", "construction": "Annual change in inventories divided by prior year total assets, using Compustat INVT and AT items.", "rationale": "Firms rapidly increasing inventories may face future write-downs or demand misestimation, while those controlling inventories may have superior operational efficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Liability Growth", "construction": "One-year change in deferred tax liabilities (Compustat TXDITC) divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "Growth in deferred tax liabilities may indicate aggressive earnings management or temporary tax benefits that could reverse, affecting future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Risk", "construction": "Estimated from 10-K segment disclosures, the proportion of total purchases from the top 3 suppliers.", "rationale": "Firms relying heavily on few suppliers may face higher operational risks, reducing expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Lease Commitment Ratio", "construction": "Total future minimum lease payments due within one year (from footnotes) divided by current assets.", "rationale": "High short-term lease obligations may signal liquidity risk or near-term cost pressures.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Productivity Change", "construction": "One-year change in sales per employee, using Compustat SALE and EMP data.", "rationale": "Firms improving productivity may enjoy competitive advantages leading to better future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Filing Intensity", "construction": "Count of patents filed in past year divided by total assets, as reported in 10-Ks and USPTO filings.", "rationale": "High patent intensity may signal innovation and future growth prospects not fully priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Working Capital Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly net working capital (current assets minus current liabilities) over the past three years, scaled by average total assets.", "rationale": "Greater volatility in working capital may indicate uncertain cash flows and operational instability.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Board Meeting Frequency", "construction": "Number of board meetings held in the prior fiscal year, as disclosed in proxy statements.", "rationale": "More frequent board meetings could reflect heightened oversight, potentially improving governance and firm performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Foreign Income Share", "construction": "Proportion of income before extraordinary items (Compustat IB) generated by foreign subsidiaries, as disclosed in segment data.", "rationale": "Firms with higher foreign income may benefit from geographic diversification and access to growth markets.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Capitalized R&D (if allowed) divided by total R&D expenditure (Compustat XRD) over the past three years.", "rationale": "A higher ratio may suggest management’s confidence in the future payoff of R&D investments.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
